question: Look at the little pull tab on almost any zipper and you will often find the same three letters stamped on it, the initials of one Japanese company. What are those three letters?
topic: Zippers: teeth, sliders and the letters on the pull
source_excerpt: the world's largest manufacturer of zippers, accounting for approximately 45% of the global market share

extra.why_interesting: Players have seen these three letters on their jeans, jackets and bags thousands of times without thinking about them. The answer is within reach for anyone who has looked down at a zipper, and the payoff is that one Japanese family firm makes about half of all zippers on Earth.
extra.verification_notes: YKK is the Japanese company whose initials appear on most zipper pulls, with about 45% of the global market; no newer developments found (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YKK).

explanation: YKK stands for Yoshida Kōgyō Kabushiki-gaisha, roughly 'Yoshida Industries Company', and this one Japanese firm makes about half of all the zippers in the world.
